name: Georgos
appearance: Sun-weathered skin and earth-stained hands tell of long days in the fields. He wears a simple undyed wool exomis pinned at one shoulder, leaving his right arm free for work, with a woven grass hat to shade his face. A rope belt holds small farming tools, and his bare feet are tough from walking furrows. His beard is flecked with grain chaff, and he often carries a bundle of wheat or a small amphora of olive oil.
